native_states.selector: Inventory.CheckEmptyState/CheckNonEmptyState use inherited Metal Table EmptyTile/FullTile and independent detail-color choice.

source_shape: Wide flat trapezoidal top over two broad perforated plate supports; occupied tile adds one tall rectangular handled/slotted mark on the right and one small mark on the left. Exact stock-item identity is not established.

palette.rule: Actual empty mask contains no covered detail pixels. Whole chrome-steel structure follows primary c, including its highlights. Occupied decorative marker follows native chosen detail. No bright-metal edge is arbitrarily assigned detail.

donor_reference.role: Actual Vanilla Textures Expanded TableMachining_south supplies readable cold metal contours, shallow plane shading and restrained edge wear only. No machinery, tools, countertop plan, facing system or crafting mechanics are copied.

construction: Retain corrected source south base and stock material at uniform shared scale. Reverse symmetric empty bench for N, construct complete end plate volume and separately project stock in N/E/W, preserving front/back holes and opaque end faces. Unseen support extrusion and stock faces are authored.
states: Inherited Metal Table EmptyTile sw_table_metal.bmp; FullTile sw_table_metal_full.bmp. Inventory.CheckEmptyState/CheckNonEmptyState independently choose comma-expanded tile/detail values. Empty C; occupied C/w/y/W. Do not correlate a new item identity to native color or reroll native state.
inventory_boundary: Table Container/Inventory population, non-takeable100-weight inorganic metal furniture, cover and sounds stay native. Stock marker represents the native occupied tile, not actual held inventory, a research bench or imported production functionality. Rare animated/custom cases retain native fallback.

normalization.scope: One whole-object transform for all empty bases and stock components in every view.
normalization.reason: Opposed view of high upright stock approaches original top border; uniform shared scale supplies reconstruction margin without per-state/view crop.

frame.rule: Same source cell, origin and scale for shared base and every stock component/role. No independent state/view bounds fitting.

native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation gate; native container/inventory/tile/detail choice,100-weight inorganic/non-takeable metal/cover/visibility, rare Animated fallback and extra-view placement remain unfinished.

camera.projection: u=8+rotated_x; v=16.9+(3.4/7.6)*rotated_y-z. Same elevation/physical dimensions for all directions.
camera.dimension_provenance: Hidden depth/support extrusion and stock thickness/placement are authored estimates from source parts/front and actual donor camera, not native length fields or a fixed end/front ratio.
camera.support_rule: Two source perforated plate supports extrude in depth. Square holes run front/back and remain visible in S/N; solid outer plate faces hide them in end views. Do not paste front holes onto end panel.

stock.identity: Unidentified native occupied marks. Plate thickness and round-form unseen placement are authored; no item/tool identity or crafting role inferred.

camera.west: Occupied stock must be separately projected: its plate and small mark change depth/overlap, not a whole mirrored occupied image.
